capsule.admissionAuthority: trusted admitCapsule(review:"off") — same authority as ordering-check and run-boundary rechecks; no owner Gate-2 receipt minted

revision.reason: Round-4 gaming-resistance hardening. Round-3 re-review found three recurring fix-class seams: (EST-pristine) the yardstick reference leg ran the SAME candidate-linked binary, so a global/static constructor in the mutable physical_filter.cpp could detect the reference leg from argv/cmdline and inflate only that timing; (CG) peak memory came from wait4 ru_maxrss of the direct child, so a detached descendant's memory escaped accounting; (THREADCAP) DuckDB threads:1 was set but no OS task/CPU cap stopped a candidate spawning worker threads to parallelize the filter across cores.
revision.challenge: single-operator physical-filter microbenchmark: one always-true string-kernel predicate (train lower(), validation upper()) over fixed SF1 lineitem behind an OFFSET 0 pushdown barrier; the filter operator carries ~47% of baseline runtime
evaluatorHardening: EST-pristine: a SEPARATE reference runner is built from the trusted baseline with NO candidate overlay (worker.py prepare_reference/build_reference) and sealed root-owned read-only BEFORE any candidate code is prepared/built/run; every reference sample uses this pristine binary, which shares zero candidate code, so a candidate cannot detect or inflate only the reference leg

CG: fresh root-only cgroup2 mounted by the trusted evaluator; each sample runs in its own leaf joined in preexec before the privilege drop; peak is read from the root-owned, kernel-owned, monotone memory.peak (whole-tree, every task accounted), replacing wait4 ru_maxrss; leaves killed+retired via cgroup.kill after every leg and a non-empty cgroup.procs fails the sample

THREADCAP: result_hash.cpp sets maximum_threads=1 AND async_threads=0 (single OS task by construction — zero regular workers, zero async workers, allocator background thread off); each sample leaf sets cpu.max to one core-equivalent (parallel filter threads throttled to one core, no wall-time gain) and pids.max=1 (kernel refuses any extra thread/fork)

runner and shared libraries root-copy sealed read-only before sampling (candidate AND pristine reference); entire candidate-owned build tree deleted (no candidate-owned executable or re-chmod-able file is ever timed)

fresh writable state per sample: per-rep working dir plus pre-sample sweep of /tmp and /dev/shm and kill/reap of any surviving demoted process (pid-1 orphan reaping included); fresh IPC and NET namespaces unshared in the demoted preexec for every candidate process
sealed assets hash-verified, copied read-only, unmounted before candidate build; oracle (target AND pristine reference) retained only in the trusted parent; exact typed-output validation per sample
evaluator runs under broker eval-container capabilities (CAP_SYS_ADMIN for cgroup/tmpfs mount, no CAP_CHOWN); verified through the real broker eval path, not only out-of-band containers

controls.role: deliberately slower but correct per-chunk volatile work

genuine work reduction — strips length(lower(x))/length(upper(x)) to length(x) (1:1 codepoint case maps preserve character count), skipping per-row utf8proc case materialization; byte-identical output
train-only bypass with bounded validation-only diagnostic delay — split inversion control

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max under permanent ambient git-status poller load; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.estimator: min-of-N ref/target reference-yardstick (score = NORM_CONST[1.0] * min(reference)/min(target) over 7 timed fresh-process target/reference pairs, 2 warmups). The filter-free reference query is run by a SEPARATE pristine runner built+sealed from the trusted baseline with no candidate overlay, so it is candidate-independent; each sample runs in its own cgroup leaf capped to one core-equivalent (cpu.max) and one task (pids.max=1); the per-binary minimum cancels shared-host contention drift.
